title: Broomdent
description: Turn your trident into a fun, fully 3D broomstick with this OptiFine-compatible Minecraft resource pack! 🧹
body:
**~~✨ Description~~**

Ever wanted to turn your trident into a broomstick? This resource pack does exactly that.

It replaces the vanilla trident with a fully custom 3D broomstick model, giving your gameplay a fun and unique twist. Whether you’re flying around or throwing it, it feels way more creative than the default trident.

The model was made using Blockbench and works with OptiFine (CEM), so you’ll need OptiFine installed for it to display properly.

**~~⚙️ Features~~**
- Custom 3D broomstick model 🧹
- Replaces the trident
- Works in first and third person
- Compatible with OptiFine (CEM)

**~~📦 Requirements~~**
- OptiFine (required)
- Minecraft Java Edition

**~~💡 Notes~~**

This is purely visual — it doesn’t change any gameplay mechanics.

**~~❤️ Credits~~**

Made with Blockbench
